name: asmodeus
comment: Live-money trading system. All db probes are read-only (SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY); a corrupt/locked db degrades to yellow 'unobservable', never a crash. Paths verified against the live filesystem 2026-07-01.

probes.query: SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM trades WHERE mode='live'
probes.comment: 2026-07-07: the old 'SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM venue_fills' referenced a table that does not exist in schema.rs (the live schema has 'trades', not 'venue_fills') -> the probe read UNOBSERVABLE forever (metric_unobservable), which is a false blind-spot, not a healthy signal. 'trades WHERE mode=live' is the live fill-recency truth (created_at is a TEXT RFC3339 stamp, parsed by probe::parse_ts). NULL (no live trades yet) degrades to yellow unobservable by design, never a crash. Market-hours awareness stays OUT of scope for Phase 1 — weekend/closed-market gaps show yellow/red honestly; a market-hours-aware threshold is a Phase 2+ follow-up.

probes.query: SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM trades WHERE status='open' AND mode='live'
probes.comment: NULL = no open live trades = nothing stuck (green by design).

probes.query: SELECT MAX(ts) FROM equity WHERE mode='live'
probes.comment: 2026-07-07: dropped the brittle literal 'source=tradelocker' (the equity recorder writes source='' by default, schema.rs equity.source DEFAULT '' — so the old filter matched zero rows and returned NULL -> yellow unobservable forever). 'mode=live' is the recorder's real partition of live vs paper equity snapshots. Best-effort: this table intermittently reads as 'database disk image is malformed' (observed 2026-07-01 and again 2026-07-07) -> such failures degrade to yellow unobservable, never a crash.
Field 't' is epoch seconds (verified). Never matched by pid — PIDs recycle.
The deploy-gap probe: the running binary's build sha vs the repo HEAD (repos.json path join). Mismatch = yellow drift warning.

probes.command: python -c "import sqlite3,os; db=os.path.expandvars(r'%LOCALAPPDATA%\Asmodeus\state\asmodeus.db'); con=sqlite3.connect('file:'+db+'?mode=ro',uri=True); k=con.execute('SELECT engaged FROM kill_switch WHERE id=1').fetchone()[0]; b=con.execute('SELECT state FROM breaker_state WHERE id=1').fetchone()[0]; frozen=os.path.exists(os.path.expandvars(r'%LOCALAPPDATA%\Asmodeus\state\LIVE_TRADING_FROZEN')); print(2 if (k or (b!='open' and not frozen)) else (1 if b!='open' else 0))"
probes.comment: breaker_state 'open' is the NORMAL state (open|pause_entries|halt, schema.rs:165). Tri-state: engaged kill-switch OR a breaker trip WITHOUT the operator freeze marker -> 2 (red, restart_forbidden — never blind-restart over an UNEXPECTED trip). Breaker not-open WITH state\LIVE_TRADING_FROZEN present -> 1 (yellow: the deliberate operator freeze; paper trading is the intended mode and the keepalive MAY relaunch). 2026-07-16: the old equals-0 sqlite probe read the deliberate freeze as red+restart_forbidden, so when a lane ship triggered asmodeus's own deploy-gap rebuild shutdown, nothing was allowed to relaunch it — the whole fleet stayed dead (~2:50 PM outage).

name: sover
comment: Autonomous social executive (GGG brand). Live state root is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Sover — the repo .runtime copy is STALE (that is what fooled the old monitor). Paths verified against the live filesystem 2026-07-01.

probes.comment: Registry is a dict keyed 'id:platform'; per-entry field is 'published_at' (naive-local timestamp, verified). 2026-07-03: split the old aggregate 'publish_recency' (path '*.published_at', newest across ALL platforms) into one probe per platform — Instagram publishing regularly masked control_tiktok/control_youtube being dead ('legacy runner no-op' stubs that update their own last_run but never actually post) because the aggregate's newest-wins semantics only needed ONE platform alive to read green.

2026-07-17 (operator-directed fix-wave): operator_gated — YouTube publishing stops when the Google session logs out, a HUMAN re-login no agent can perform (the 'published 0 / held — logged out' state). The red stays honestly red, but the ops rollup marks red_operator_gated_only when no UNGATED probe is also red, so growth::eligible_repo keeps composing for the healthy platforms (IG/TikTok) instead of reading the whole engine as dead.
One blip is yellow; three consecutive failed sweeps is red.

probes.pattern: failed after 3 attempts|auto_post is OFF|chrome binary not found|exited during startup

probes.comment: The LIVE lane state under %LOCALAPPDATA% — NOT the stale repo copy. Split from the old single 'lane_freshness' probe (which watched dead 'post.last_run') after sover's 2026-07-01/02 migration from a single 'post' lane to per-platform control_<platform> lanes — see engine/catalog.rs FULL-REPLACEMENT model. The old field is permanently orphaned (the scheduler never runs a retired lane name), so it read a false 21h+ RED forever.
2026-07-17 (operator-directed fix-wave): operator_gated for the same reason as publish_recency_youtube — the control_youtube lane holds while the Google session is logged out (human-only re-login).
auto_post silently OFF is the classic silent-stop; anything but true is red.

name: dotz
comment: 2026-07-14 (Phase 2): removed the heartbeat_fresh probe — dotz is a DESKTOP APP, not a daemon. It does not run continuously, so it cannot produce a fresh heartbeat.json updated_at while closed. The probe expected age < 24h (red_after_s: 86400), which is impossible for a desktop app only open during use — it read a false RED forever (162 consecutive, age 54.8h) over a healthy lane. The lane's real outcome signal is outcome_streak (shipped iterations in history.jsonl); that stays. If dotz is ever reoriented to a daemon/always-on service, re-add a heartbeat probe then.

probes.comment: 2026-07-17 (operator-directed fix-wave): the growth MEASURE leg, mirroring maki's. dotz has no growth_publish block yet, so the marker records mode:not_opted_in dispatches (published:false) — this probe measures the auto-publish seam's dispatch recency and the ledger glue records the honest mode. When the operator wires a sanctioned dotz release lane, add the matching growth_artifact_fresh evidence probe. Yellow-only: no red_after_s, same rationale as maki's.

2026-07-17 (operator-directed fix-wave): the growth MEASURE leg. Reads the auto-publish marker growth.rs writes on every dispatch ({signature, published, mode, ts}) — maki's 2026-07-16 live publish was the fleet's first real growth experiment and had NO measurement probe. Yellow-only by design (no red_after_s): a quiet marketing week is not an engine outage, and the eligible_repo green-before-growth gate must never be wedged by a slow publish cadence. Missing file = never dispatched = honest yellow unobservable. ops/ledger.rs growth_publish_activity mirrors this file into the outcomes ledger so the published -> measured loop closes.

2026-07-17 (operator-directed fix-wave): produced-artifact EVIDENCE for maki's sanctioned publish lane (scripts/build-release.ps1 -> signed NSIS installer; the filename carries the version). A growth_publish_recency green with published:true but NO matching installer is a publish claim without evidence — the June 30 empty-url lesson applied to installers. Yellow-only: absence/staleness degrades to unobservable/yellow, never red (release cadence is operator-paced). ops/ledger.rs growth_artifact_activity mirrors newest-name+mtime into the outcomes ledger.

2026-07-14 (Phase 2): widened from yellow>600s/red>1800s to yellow>3600s/red>10800s. Solomon is a DESKTOP APP the operator opens intermittently — the old 30min RED threshold false-alarmed every time the operator closed it for >30min (the normal idle state), reading RED 5 consecutive over a 2.9h gap that was just 'app closed'. The watchdog appends here every ~2min while Solomon.exe is OPEN; stale while closed is the honest blind-window signal. 1h yellow / 3h red catches a genuinely-stuck-open sweep (tick thread died) within 3h without noising on normal 'app closed for an hour'. If solomon is ever run as an always-on daemon, tighten this back to the 10min/30min cadence.

probes.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$lines = Get-Content 'runtime\autopilot_events.jsonl' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $lines) { Write-Output '0'; exit 0 }; $now = Get-Date; $since = $now.AddHours(-24); $proof = 0; $impl = 0; foreach ($l in $lines) { try { $r = $l | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }; if ($r.event -ne 'job_finished') { continue }; if ([DateTime]$r.ts -le $since) { continue }; if ($r.job -eq 'proof_required' -and $r.outcome -eq 'proof_required') { $proof++ }; if ($r.job -eq 'implement' -and ($r.outcome -eq 'shipped' -or $r.outcome -eq 'proof_required' -or $r.outcome -eq 'blocked')) { $impl++ } }; if ($impl -eq 0) { Write-Output '0' } else { Write-Output ([math]::Round($proof / $impl, 2)) }"
probes.comment: 2026-07-14 (Phase 2): the fleet-health proof_required/implement ratio over a 24h window from autopilot_events.jsonl. >1.5 -> yellow (the loop is spinning on inert proof_required more than it runs real implement jobs), >2.5 -> red (retry theater — e.g. the 3.57:1 fleet-wide and 53:1 dotz ratios that prompted the proof_required cooldown). 0 (or no implement jobs in window) -> green (no denominator = no theater). The pure core (fleet::proof_implement_ratio) is unit-tested in cargo test; this cmd probe is the ops-plane surface that exposes it on the dashboard / `solomon probe`. The PowerShell is a thin reader: it counts job_finished events in the 24h window by (job, outcome) exactly as the Rust core does.
